info.name: Event Manager - RSVP & Waitlist
info.description: RSVP service: Turnstile-verified replies, first reply only once, capacity in a locked transaction, waitlist order and promotion, guest changes and cancellation, organizer moderation. Covers valid, invalid, wrong-role and other-owner requests.

}
